x-e-e1-01.title: Tsvaga zviito zvisingaenderani nechiziviso chechitoro chokushambira
x-e-e1-01.topic: Kukwazisa kupfupi, zviziviso, nemifananidzo yakadhirowa nemashoko
x-e-e1-01.goal: Enzanisa mitemo mitatu iri pachiziviso nemamiriro omunhu wega wega, sarudza mamiriro anoputsa mitemo, uye utaure chikonzero muChirungu.
x-e-e1-01.material:
'Chiziviso pamusuwo wepuranga rokushambira (chakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = munhu mukuru)

Vanhu vana vari kuenda kupuranga rokushambira.
Mina is 7. She comes with her mom, and she has a cap.
Jun is 10. He comes alone, and he has no cap.
Tom is 6. He comes with his brother. His brother is 9. Tom has a cap.
Sue is 11. She walks to the pool alone, and she has a cap.'
x-e-e1-01.thinking.0: Shandisa mitemo kumunhu wega wega zvakasiyana
x-e-e1-01.prereq.1: Mazwi akareruka okumiririra akaita se I, you, he, she
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Gadzira tafura ine zera romunhu wega wega, kuti akauya nani, nekapu, mumwe nomumwe.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga kuti mutemo wega wega unobatana neruzivo rupi, uye uvabatanidze nemitsetse.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.a: Tarisa kana wakaenzanisa zera raMina nokuti akauya nani nomutemo 3.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.c: Funga kana munhu akauya naTom ari munhu mumwe chete nomunhu anotaurwa nomutemo.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.d: Enzanisa zera raSue nenzira yaanofamba nayo nemitemo 1 ne 3 zvakasiyana.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.explain: Jun haana kapu, saka anoputsa mutemo 2. Tom ari pasi pe 8, asi mukoma wake akauya naye ari 9, saka haasi 'grown-up', uye Tom anoputsa mutemo 3. Mina akauya naamai vake, uye Sue ana 11, saka zvakanaka kuti afambe auye ega.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.prompt: Udza mukoma waTom mumutsara mumwe kana maviri muChirungu. Batanidza nomutemo chikonzero chokuti Tom haagoni kupinda mupuranga izvozvi.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga waenzanisa zera raTom nenhamba iri mumutemo 3.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga ne 'Tom is under 8, so ...' uye unyore chinodikanwa shure kwacho.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakabatanidza here nomutemo (pasi pe 8) chikonzero chokuti Tom haagoni kupinda?
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti sei mukoma wake asiri grown-up?
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Mitsara yako yeChirungu iri pfupi uye yakareruka kunzwisisa here?

x-e-e1-02.topic: Kukwazisa kupfupi, zviziviso, nemifananidzo yakadhirowa nemashoko
x-e-e1-02.title: Ruramisa mutsetse wakanganisa muchiziviso chezvakarasika chakakopwa
x-e-e1-02.goal: Enzanisa chiziviso chezvakarasika nomeseji yakakopwa nashamwari kubva pacho, mutsetse nomutsetse, tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa, uye uunyore patsva zvakarurama.
x-e-e1-02.material:
'Chiziviso pabhodhi rechikoro (chakanyorwa nemashoko chete):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Shamwari yako Jia akaona chiziviso ichi nokuti ainge achitsvaga bhodhoro rake remvura, uye akatumira meseji kuna Hana. Hana anoda kuienzanisa nechiziviso.'
x-e-e1-02.prereq.1: Kuverenga nhamba dzamakamuri senge Room 1, Room 3
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe mumeseji yaJia unosiyana nechiziviso.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Nongedza mashoko ari muchiziviso (ruvara, nhamba yekamuri, zita romunhu) rimwe nerimwe uye uaenzanise nemitsetse yemeseji.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kumutsetse wega wega wemeseji, uuenzanise nomutsetse wechiziviso waunokopa, uye utsvage izwi risingaenderani.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 4 wakanganisa. Muchiziviso, Ms. Park ari muRoom 1, asi meseji inoti Room 3, saka zvakanganisa. Bhuruu yomutsetse 2 yakafanana nechiziviso, uye Room 3 yomutsetse 3 ndipo pakawanikwa bhodhoro, saka yakarurama.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.prompt: Ruramisa mutsetse wakanganisa wawakangowana kuti uenderane nechiziviso, uye uunyore muChirungu.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga zvakare mutsetse muchiziviso unotanga ne 'Ask'.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Pane izwi rimwe chete rokuchinja mumutsara wepakutanga. Tsvaga kuti izwi iroro riri papi.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here muchiziviso nhamba yekamuri yaanogara Ms. Park?
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakasiyanisa here nzvimbo yakawanikwa bhodhoro (Room 3) nenzvimbo yokubvunza (Room 1)?

x-e-e1-03.topic: Kukwazisa kupfupi, zviziviso, nemifananidzo yakadhirowa nemashoko
x-e-e1-03.title: Gadzira chiziviso chemitsara miviri kuti uchiise pamusuwo wekirasi
x-e-e1-03.goal: Tonga kuti ruzivo rupi (papi, riini) runodikanwa nomuverengi wechiziviso, sarudza chiziviso chinokodzera, uye unyore chiziviso chako chemitsara miviri.
x-e-e1-03.material: Vadzidzi veKirasi 3 vari mukamuri yemhanzi kubva pa 10:00 kusvika pa 11:00 nhasi. Vanoda kuisa chiziviso pamusuwo wekirasi. Mushanyi anouya kukirasi yeKirasi 3 pa 10:30 achaverenga chiziviso ichi.
x-e-e1-03.prereq.0: Mashoko akareruka akaita se music room, today
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza chiziviso chinoita kuti mushanyi anouya pa 10:30 azive zvose 'kuenda kupi' ne 'kumirira kwenguva yakadini'.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mibvunzo miviri yaungada kubvunzwa nomushanyi.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ratidza rimwe nerimwe kana chiziviso chega chega chichipindura mibvunzo miviri iyoyo.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.r.b: Funga kana unogona kuziva kuti 'later' ndinguva yakadini.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.r.c: Tarisa kana chiziviso ichi chichitaura zvose zviviri zvinoda mushanyi kuziva.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.r.d: Tarisa kana chine nguva yokutanga chete, kana nenguva yokupera zvakare.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.explain: c inoudza zvose nzvimbo (music room) nenguva yokupera (11:00). Mu a nzvimbo yashayikwa, mu b kuti kwenguva yakadini kwashayikwa, uye mu d nguva yokupera yashayikwa.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.prompt: Nyora chiziviso muChirungu, mumitsara miviri, chokuisa pamusuwo wekirasi yeKirasi 3. Chinofanira kusanganisira nzvimbo nokuti kusvika nguva ipi.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora izwi rimwe rimwe rapapi, riini, nomunhu ani.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora 'papi' pamutsetse wokutanga ne 'riini' pamutsetse wechipiri, wobva warurama.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Munhu anopfuura anogona kuiverenga akaziva papi, uye kusvika nguva ipi here?
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaisa ruzivo rwunodikanwa chete mumitsara miviri here?
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakasarudza here ruzivo rumwe rwauchida kuwedzera (semuenzaniso, Class 3, Please wait)? (Sarudzo)

x-e-e1-04.title: Mutauri ndiani? Kuchinja kufunga kwako zviratidzo zvichiwedzera
x-e-e1-04.topic: Zviratidzo pamusoro pomunhu ani, chii, nepapi
x-e-e1-04.goal: Nguva imwe neimwe mutsara wokutaura uchiwedzera chiratidzo, tongazve kuti mutauri ndiani, uye utsanangure chiratidzo chinosarudza muChirungu.
x-e-e1-04.material: Uchaona mitsara inotaurwa nomunhu, mumwe panguva imwe. Tevera zviratidzo ufunge kuti mutauri ndiani.
x-e-e1-04.thinking.0: Chengeta mikana yakawanda ichiri pachena kubva pachiratidzo chimwe
x-e-e1-04.prereq.0: Mashoko akareruka akaita se book, card, week
x-e-e1-04.prereq.1: Kukwazisa kwakaita se Welcome, Can I help you?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.prompt: Mitsara inouya mumwe nomumwe. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza vanhu vose vanogona kuva mutauri.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kuvanhu vawakasiya munhanho yapfuura, tarisazve kana vanoenderana nomutsara mutsva.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.hint.1: Mumutsara mutsva, tsvaga mashoko anopa zita 'chinhu' kana 'nguva'.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Uchitarisa mutsara mumwe uyu chete, mutauri angava ani?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kubva pamutsara wokutanga oga, vanhu vakawanda vanogoneka, senge mushandi wechitoro kana mushandi weraibhurari.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Vanhu vari muzvitoro vanopawo kukwazisa kwakadaro.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Funga kana kukwazisa uku kuchiwanzoshandiswa mubhazi.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Vanhu vari muraibhurari vanobvunzawo mashoko okupa rubatsiro.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Vanhu vari muzvitoro zvinotengesa mabhuku vanopawo kukwazisa kwakafanana.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Mabhuku akabuda, saka mushandi wechitoro chembatya nomutyairi webhazi vakabva. Mushandi weraibhurari nomushandi wechitoro chemabhuku vanosara.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Anogona kuva munhu panzvimbo ine mabhuku.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Anogona kuva munhu muchitoro chine mabhuku.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kubatanidza mitsara yose mitatu, ndiani anokodzera zvikuru?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Sezvo mutauri achikumbira kuona kadhi uye achiti unogona kuchengeta bhuku kwemavhiki maviri, zvikuru kuti mushandi weraibhurari anokweretesa mabhuku. Muchitoro chemabhuku, kana ukatenga bhuku kazhinji hapana nguva.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Funga kuti 'two weeks' ne 'card' zvaizoreva chii muchitoro chemabhuku.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Funga kuti mashoko okuti card ne two weeks anoita chii.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.reflect: Kana wakasarudza munhu mumwe kubva pamutsara wokutanga oga, tarisazve kuti kufunga kwako kwakachinja sei sezviratidzo zvitsva zvichibuda. Mikana yakadzikira nechiratidzo chega chega.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.prompt: Nyora muChirungu chiratidzo chimwe mumutsara wokupedzisira chinoita kuti ufunge 'librarian' kwete 'bookshop clerk'.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.hint.0: Mumutsara wokupedzisira, tsvaga izwi raizoshandiswa zvakasiyana muchitoro chemabhuku nomuraibhurari.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora mutsara mumwe muchimiro: '__ means ~, so ...'.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here kuti chiratidzo chawakasarudza chinoparadzanisa chaizvo chitoro chemabhuku neraibhurari?
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here kuti 'card' kana 'two weeks' zvinoita chii?

'Vanhu vaviri vanotaura seizvi.
A: Two tickets, please.
B: Which film?

B: Row F or Row G?

(Row = mutsetse wezvigaro, film = bhaisikopu)

x-e-e1-06.topic: Zviratidzo pamusoro pomunhu ani, chii, nepapi
x-e-e1-06.title: Chinhu chisinganzwisisike: tinofanira kubvunza chii chinotevera?
x-e-e1-06.goal: Kana vakasarudzwa vakawanda vachiri pachena, sarudza mubvunzo unoparadzanisa vakasarudzwa zvakanakisa, uye ugadzire mubvunzo wako weChirungu.

'Shamwari iri kufunga chinhu. Pane zviratidzo zviviri.
Hint 1: It is round. (It is round and roundish)

Pane vakasarudzwa vana: apple, plate, clock, ne cup. Unoda kuwana chimwe nokubvunza mibvunzo ye yes/no.'
